jobs.title: Director - Enterprise Data Modernization Lead (GCP)
jobs.description:
Position Description

We are seeking a Director, Consulting Expert (DCE) – Enterprise Data Modernization Lead (GCP) to provide senior technical, solutioning, and client facing leadership

The DCE will serve as a trusted advisor to the client while helping shape, win, govern, and successfully deliver complex enterprise data initiatives.

This is not a narrow technical specialist or delivery only position. The DCE combines deep enterprise data warehouse and modern data platform expertise with consulting acumen, architecture leadership, commercial awareness, and executive presence. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior client stakeholders, shaping and estimating solutions, leading architecture decisions, and engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineering teams.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Serve as a senior client facing advisor for enterprise data warehouse, data engineering, analytics, and data platform modernization initiatives within a complex telecommunications environment.
Translate business objectives and requirements into actionable data strategies, architectures, roadmaps, and solution options.
Lead end to end solution architecture, considering data, applications, integration, cloud, cybersecurity, operations, cost, scalability, and delivery trade offs.
Architect and guide enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including technologies such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Dataplex, Dataform, and Looker.
Provide technical leadership across enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, data quality, metadata, governance, security, and analytics.
Lead or co lead technical solutioning for strategic pursuits, proposals, RFPs, and account growth opportunities.
Develop and challenge solution scope, architecture, assumptions, estimates, resource models, dependencies, risks, and delivery approaches to ensure solutions are competitive and executable.
Orchestrate SMEs across data, cloud, applications, integration, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations to develop cohesive end to end solutions.
Lead or participate in architecture, estimation, proposal, and delivery governance reviews, identifying technical and delivery risks before commitments are made.
Advise on AI/ML and generative AI data readiness, including data quality, accessibility, governance, privacy, security, and responsible adoption.
Maintain sufficient hands on technical depth to challenge designs, validate assumptions, troubleshoot critical issues, and defend architectural decisions.
Mentor architects and technical leads and promote reusable architectures, patterns, accelerators, and solution assets across the team.
Partner with the DCS and broader P&L leadership to strengthen the client relationship, identify growth opportunities, improve solution quality, and develop technical leadership capability within the team.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

10+ years of progressively responsible experience in leading enterprise data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, solution architecture, or related IT consulting disciplines.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex enterprise data warehouse and modern cloud data platform solutions.
Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its data and analytics ecosystem, particularly Big Query and associated ingestion, processing, orchestration, governance, and analytics capabilities.
Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, ETL/ELT, data integration, data quality, metadata, security, governance, and analytics.
Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of modern data engineering technologies and practices such as Python, Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, APIs, and automated testing/deployment.
Experience with enterprise data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata, Informatica, DataStage, dbt, or comparable platforms.
Demonstrated experience leading solution architecture for significant client engagements, proposals, RFPs, or complex technology pursuits.
Experience developing or validating solution estimates, delivery models, assumptions, dependencies, and technical risks.
Strong consulting and executive communication skills, including discovery, problem framing, facilitation, solution development, and client presentations.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams, influence senior stakeholders, and mentor architects and technical leaders.
Working knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI concepts and their implications for enterprise data architecture and governance.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience delivering data and analytics solutions within the telecommunications industry, with an understanding of large scale, high volume telco data environments and associated business and operational use cases.
Google Cloud certification, particularly Professional Cloud Architect and/or Professional Data Engineer, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
Experience modernizing large legacy or on premises enterprise data warehouse environments to GCP.
Experience within a large IT consulting, systems integration, managed services, or professional services organization.
Experience supporting large, complex and highly integrated enterprise technology environments.
Commercial awareness encompassing consulting economics, solution costing, delivery risk, and value based solutioning.

Leadership Profile

The successful DCE will be a visible, take charge consulting leader who:

Leads with client and business outcomes rather than technology alone.
Has the executive presence to independently lead senior client conversations.
Takes ownership of ambiguous or difficult solution problems and drives them to resolution.
Retains enough hands on technical depth to challenge and defend important architecture decisions.
Challenges unrealistic estimates, unsupported assumptions, scope gaps, and delivery risks before commitments are made.
Works across organizational and technology boundaries rather than operating as a narrow or isolated SME.
Coaches and develops architects and technical leaders, raising the capability of the broader team.

Measures of Success

Success will be reflected in stronger client relationships, higher quality solutions and estimates, improved pursuit outcomes, reduced delivery risk, successful enterprise data initiatives, and increased technical capability across the team.

The DCE will be recognized by the client, delivery teams, DCS, and broader P&L leadership as a trusted senior advisor who connects telecommunications business outcomes, enterprise data architecture, technology, commercial realities, and delivery feasibility.

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $135,000–$185,000. This role is an existing vacancy.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

jobs.title: Responsable senior de projets numériques et IA / Senior Digital & AI Project Leader
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Responsable senior de projets numériques et IA / Senior Digital & AI Project Leader

***English job description follows***

Description de l'emploi :

Vous avez une solide expérience en gestion de projets complexes, vous avez travaillé dans le domaine numérique et la transformation par l'IA et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences? Ce poste est pour vous!

Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Responsable de projets numériques et IA pour rejoindre notre équipe Solutions Numériques (ABSD) basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez conjointement avec les équipes Business et IM basées à Mirabel et Toulouse.

Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de gestion de projet de solutions numériques des services à la clientèle, chargée de diriger des projets pour un ensemble complet de produits et services numériques couvrant :

Des solutions numériques et d’IA pour l'ensemble de l'organisation des services à la clientèle
Services digitaux eSolutions directement déployés auprès de nos Clients (Compagnies Aériennes)

L'organisation de l'équipe est établie pour promouvoir la collaboration croisée de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement.

Votre rôle en tant que Responsable de projets numériques et IA sera de définir et diriger la feuille de route stratégique de transformation numérique et d'IA, tout en assurant la livraison du portefeuille de projets complexes.

Votre environnement de travail:

Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre.

Parce que nous prenons soin de vous:

Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions.
Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride, une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle.
Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, service de navette gratuite entre Montréal et Mirabel et application de covoiturage.
Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale).

Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.

Vos défis:

Définir et piloter la feuille de route stratégique de transformation numérique et d'IA alignée sur les objectifs globaux des Services Clientèle;
Cadrer, évaluer et déployer des solutions basées sur l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, prédictive et automatisation) dans les processus métiers et produits clients;
Diriger la livraison de portefeuilles de projets complexes (CapEx/OpEx) dans le respect des délais, des budgets et des standards de qualité (Digital Gates)`;
Superviser les budgets des projets et établir des cadres d'évaluation de la valeur ajoutée et du retour sur investissement (ROI);
Piloter la stratégie globale de gestion du changement pour garantir l'adoption optimale des nouvelles technologies par les équipes internes et les clients;
Assurer l'alignement stratégique et la coordination transversale entre les parties prenantes Métier et IM réparties entre Mirabel et Toulouse.;
Gérer les relations stratégiques avec les fournisseurs externes, la négociation des mandats et le suivi des engagements contractuels;
Identifier et atténuer proactivement les risques liés aux projets, à la cybersécurité, à la protection des données et à la conformité de l'IA.

Votre profil:

Diplôme universitaire pertinent en ingénierie, informatique, gestion des systèmes d'information, administration des affaires ou dans une discipline connexe;
Minimum de dix (10) ans d'expérience en gestion de projets numériques et en conduite de transformations organisationnelles d'envergure à l'échelle de l'entreprise;
Expérience avérée dans l'intégration opérationnelle de solutions numériques avancées et de technologies basées sur l'intelligence artificielle;
Solide expertise en gestion des parties prenantes et capacité à influencer et aligner des équipes décisionnelles dans un environnement matriciel international;
Maîtrise éprouvée des méthodologies structurées de gestion du changement et de conduite de l'adoption par les utilisateurs;
Excellentes capacités d'analyse, d'arbitrage stratégique et d'évaluation financière de projets;
Niveau avancé en français et en anglais (oral et écrit).

En raison du secteur d’activité (aéronautique), de multiples contacts avec des entités Airbus situées dans le monde entier, et d’interactions avec les fournisseurs et clients également situés dans le monde entier, la connaissance de l’anglais est demandée dans ce poste.

Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.

Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant !

Job description :

Do you have solid experience in managing complex projects, have you worked in the digital and AI transformation domain and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you!

The A220 commercial aircraft program is looking for a Senior Digital & AI Project Leader to join our Digital Solutions team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will work jointly with the Business & IM teams based in Mirabel and Toulouse.

You will be part of the Customer Services Digital Solutions Project Management team responsible for leading projects for a full set of digital products and services covering:

Digital and AI solutions for the full range of Customer Services organization
eSolutions digital services directly deployed to our Customers (Airlines)

The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively.

Your role as Senior Digital and AI Project Leader
will be to define and lead the strategic digital and AI transformation roadmap while driving the delivery of complex project portfolios.

Your working environment:

The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home.

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan.
Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy, on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.
Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, free shuttle service between Montreal and Mirabel and carpooling application.
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

Your challenges:

Define and lead the strategic digital and AI transformation roadmap aligned with overarching Customer Services goals;
Evaluate, frame, and deploy artificial intelligence solutions (generative, predictive AI, and automation) within business workflows and customer platforms;
Drive the delivery of complex project portfolios (CapEx/OpEx) ensuring alignment with time, budget, and quality standards (Digital Gates);
Oversee project budgets and establish frameworks to measure business value and return on investment (ROI);
Lead overarching organizational change management strategies to ensure high adoption of new tools across internal teams and airline clients;
Ensure strategic alignment and cross-functional coordination between Business and IM stakeholders across Mirabel and Toulouse;
Manage strategic third-party vendor relationships, statement of work negotiation, and contract delivery performance;
Proactively identify and mitigate project risks, cybersecurity requirements, data privacy, and AI compliance standards.

Your boarding pass:

Relevant university degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline;
Minimum ten (10) years of experience managing digital projects and orchestrating large-scale, enterprise-level organizational transformations;
Proven track record in the operational integration of advanced digital solutions and artificial intelligence technologies;
Strong stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence and align decision-making teams in a global matrix organization;
Proven proficiency in structured change management methodologies and driving user adoption;
Strong analytical skills, strategic decision-making ability, and financial project evaluation expertise;
Advanced language skills in both French and English (spoken and written).

This role may involve some travels for business (worldwide).

Due to the sector of activity (aerospace), frequent contacts with Airbus entities worldwide, and interactions with suppliers and clients also located across the globe, proficiency in English is required for this position.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

jobs.title: Head of Information Technology - Enterprise Systems and Software Delivery
jobs.description:
Head of Information Technology - Enterprise Systems and Software Delivery
AutoShack - Kanata, Ontario

$160,000-$190,000 per year | Full-time, permanent | On-site

About AutoShack AutoShack is an established automotive parts company with approximately 170 employees, a large distribution centre, 13 Ontario retail locations and significant Canadian and U.S. e-commerce operations. We are continuing to expand our retail and online business.
The Position The Head of Information Technology is accountable for the reliable 24/7 operation of AutoShack's business-critical technology across e-commerce, retail, warehouse and corporate operations. The role leads enterprise systems, software development, integrations, automation, AI, projects and day-to-day IT operations. It manages a small internal team, developers, service providers and specialist contractors.
This is an applications and software-delivery leadership role, not a network administrator position. The Head of IT needs enough network, infrastructure and cybersecurity knowledge to manage providers and risk. The main focus is business systems, software, automation, daily operations and BCDR.
Key Responsibilities ·    Own the 24/7 availability and performance of enterprise systems, software, integrations and daily IT operations, including service levels, security and BCDR.
·    Lead the internal IT team, software developers, service providers and specialist contractors with clear priorities and accountability.
·    Own the roadmap and performance of ERP, WMS, e-commerce, PIM, integration, contact-centre and other business-critical platforms supporting company growth.
·    Direct internal and contracted software development, including requirements, estimates, architecture, testing, change control, releases, documentation and support.
·    Ensure APIs, integrations and data flows between systems are reliable, secure, documented and properly monitored.
·    Evaluate practical AI and automation opportunities, protect company data, use the right internal or outside resources and confirm measurable business value.
·    Work with department leaders to translate operating requirements into practical system changes and continuity procedures that protect critical operating processes.
·    Assign internal or outside resources, set clear owners, hours, costs and delivery dates, remove roadblocks and drive work through to completion.
·    Manage technology projects from scope and budget through development, testing, deployment and support, and deliver the agreed result on time and within budget.
·    Manage software vendors, licensing, contracts, renewals, service levels and outside development work, and challenge unnecessary costs or complexity.
·    Provide brief, accurate updates on results, major risks, costs and decisions required without unnecessary reporting.
·    Manage service providers and contractors used across IT and hold them accountable for cost, quality, service levels and delivery.
·    Own cybersecurity governance, identity and access, monitoring, backups, disaster recovery and incident response, while ensuring providers meet their obligations.
·    Maintain and regularly test BCDR plans for critical systems and operating processes, including backup restoration, recovery priorities, responsibilities, escalation contacts and temporary workarounds.
·    Maintain accurate records for systems, access, decisions, changes, project status, vendor contacts, contracts and recovery procedures without allowing administration to delay execution.
·    Maintain appropriate monitoring, incident escalation and support coverage for 24/7 operations, and reduce repeat issues.
Enterprise Technology Environment ·    NetSuite ERP and retail WMS
·    Manhattan SCALE warehouse management system
·    Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Marketing Cloud
·    Dell Boomi integrations, APIs and automated data flows
·    Marketplace feeds, e-commerce integrations and custom applications
·    Talkdesk contact-centre platform
·    Microsoft 365, endpoints, network services, cybersecurity, backup and disaster recovery
·    Internal and contracted developers, managed service and technology vendors
Required Qualifications ·    At least 10 years of progressive IT experience, including five years leading an IT team or function.
·    Experience managing IT in a mid-sized, multi-location business.
·    Proven experience leading developers, contracted development, enterprise applications and technology providers.
·    Strong knowledge of ERP, WMS, e-commerce, PIM, middleware, APIs and integrations.
·    Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle, from requirements and estimates through testing, release, source control and documentation.
·    Practical understanding of AI and automation, including data privacy, security, accuracy, vendor risk and business value.
·    Proven delivery of enterprise-system implementations and software projects, with accountability for developer quality, budget and deadlines.
·    Proven experience developing and testing BCDR plans for critical systems and business processes.
·    Working knowledge of networks, infrastructure and cybersecurity sufficient to direct providers, assess risk and maintain reliable operations.
·    A record of setting priorities, solving problems and completing work with accurate documentation.
·    Strong business judgment and the ability to explain technical issues in clear, direct language.
·    Excellent written and spoken English.
·    Proven accountability for 24/7 critical IT operations, including incident escalation, service continuity and vendor coordination.
·    Able to work on-site in Kanata five days per week.
Preferred Experience ·    Retail, distribution, warehouse, e-commerce or automotive-parts experience.
·    NetSuite, Manhattan SCALE, Salesforce Commerce Cloud or Dell Boomi experience.
·    Experience managing custom development, integrations, APIs, AI automation and data-quality improvements.
·    Experience supporting business expansion across multiple locations.
·    Experience improving an IT department by clarifying roles, reducing unnecessary work and using outside specialists effectively.
Our Workplace AutoShack is a practical, direct and results-focused company. We value hard work, accountability, sound judgment, professional conduct and consistent follow-through. This role is best suited to a business-minded, company-minded leader who puts the company's interests first, avoids unnecessary complexity, makes decisions, sets clear standards and takes responsibility for results.
Benefits Benefits include dental care, extended health care, life insurance, vision care and on-site parking.
Application and Screening Process Your resume must show systems managed, teams and providers led and completed projects with measurable results.
Shortlisted candidates will complete TestGorilla assessments in Software Engineering Management, Leadership and People Management, Business Judgment, Data Security and Compliance, and Communication Intermediate. Interviews will cover enterprise systems, software development, automation, AI, 24/7 operations and BCDR, followed by reference checks.

jobs.title: Director, Global Strategy - Enterprise Planning
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the Director of Global Enterprise Planning on the Strategy team, you architect the planning system that connects Arc’teryx’s long-term strategy to annual priorities, resource allocation, and performance accountability. This is a systems-level role: you own the infrastructure that keeps leadership aligned, decisions grounded, and execution honest.

You own the enterprise planning process end-to-end – Strategic Planning Kickoff, Long-term Strategic Planning, AOP/budget prioritization, and Quarterly Business Reporting – while also owning the broader operating infrastructure: Excom and Board of Directors preparation, the strategic calendar, and the decision frameworks that ensure the right conversations happen with the right information at the right time.

You bring both architectural thinking and executional precision. You know when to build a new system and when to simplify an existing one. You are a credible executive partner, comfortable working directly with functional leaders and Finance to drive planning rigour across a complex, global business.

This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid work (or remote Canada with travels to North Vancouver, BC). Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Strategy team is a trusted partner to the executive leadership team in the development, prioritization, and oversight of our company strategies working cross-functionally across the business to ensure attainment of our long-term strategic objectives and goals. We provide strategic insights and frameworks to enable strategy development, cross-functional alignment and executive decision making. We are experts at translating complex, unstructured problems into clear executive level narrative and recommendations. Our team leads the company’s long-range strategic planning process, quarterly business reviews, and the development of an integrated performance management framework to connect our strategy to our annual operating budget and tactical operating plan.

If you were the Director, Global Strategy - Enterprise Planning here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Owning the design, governance, and continuous evolution of the enterprise planning system, ensuring strategic planning, annual operating planning, resource allocation, and performance reporting operate as an integrated enterprise process

Leading the execution of the enterprise planning cycle, including Strategic Planning Kickoff, Long-Term Strategic Planning, and Quarterly Business Reviews, and partnering with Finance on Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and budget prioritization connected to business strategy

Establishing and governing the enterprise planning cadence, ensuring cross-functional alignment, decision readiness, and the timely progression of key strategic milestones

Building and maintaining the decision frameworks, governance structures, and planning standards that support enterprise-wide prioritization, accountability, and effective decision-making

Partnering closely with Finance and business leaders to translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, resource allocation decisions, and measurable outcomes

Leading the planning and coordination of Executive Committee and Board reviews, ensuring strategic issues are clearly framed, decisions are supported by relevant insights, and resulting actions are effectively tracked

Managing the enterprise portfolio of strategic initiatives, tracking progress, interdependencies, risks, and outcomes while escalating issues requiring executive attention

Developing scenarios, business cases, and trade-off analyses that enable leaders to evaluate opportunities, risks, investments, and resource allocation decisions

Providing fact-based analysis, insights, and recommendations to support executive decision-making, prioritization, and enterprise performance discussions

Establishing enterprise performance management frameworks, scorecards, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms that drive accountability, transparency, and execution against strategic objectives

Driving alignment across executive leadership, functions, regions, Finance, and Amer Sports to establish a consistent enterprise planning and performance management operating model

Maintaining visibility to key strategic and execution risks, ensuring mitigation plans are developed, monitored, and integrated into enterprise planning processes

Developing executive-level communications, planning documents, and leadership briefings that translate complex business information into clear priorities, recommendations, and actions

Serving as the steward of enterprise planning effectiveness, continuously evaluating planning processes, governance, and reporting mechanisms to improve decision quality, organizational alignment, and business outcomes

Developing and maintaining the tools, templates, governance processes, and planning methodologies that strengthen enterprise planning capability and support execution against strategic and business plans

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Evolving the enterprise planning system as the business scales—adding new planning horizons, integrating regional complexity, and improving the speed and quality of decisions

Building repeatable frameworks and playbooks for planning processes that reduce dependency on heroic individual effort and increase organizational capability

Partnering with Finance and regional teams to develop integrated financial and strategic planning models that connect long-range ambition to annual resource reality

Developing the next generation of performance management tools—moving from tracking to accountability, and from reporting to action

Supporting the Strategy team’s broader operating model evolution as new capability areas come online

Are you our next Director, Global Strategy - Enterprise Planning?

You have a bachelor’s degree in business, strategy, or related field

You have 10+ years of professional work experience in strategic planning, management consulting, project management, consumer products and/or retail

You have a demonstrated track record as an outstanding problem solver and strategic You think in systems – you can see how the strategic planning connects to the budget planning, how the QBR connects to accountability, and how the strategic calendar creates or destroys leadership bandwidth

You are a credible executive partner with the communication skills to work directly with a CDR and functional leaders, and to translate complexity into decisions

You have significant experience partnering with Finance on resource allocation, budget prioritization, and performance tracking

You bring sharp analytical capability and strong written communication, and you can build a rigorous framework and write a clear executive brief

You have experience working across regional and global operating models, ideally with exposure to retail or consumer-facing businesses

You are organized without being rigid, and you know when the plan needs to change and how to move the system accordingly

You demonstrate high emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to influence without authority across senior stakeholders

You hold yourself and others to a high standard for quality of thinking, clarity of communication, and follow-through

Compensation:
The salary range for this role is CAD$149,000 - CAD$195,000 

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

Health & wellbeing
- Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Financial wellbeing
- RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.

Time & Flexibilit
y - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).

Family support
- Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.

Growth, community & gear
- Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events) , Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).
  *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.

new_jobs.title: Head of Information Technology - Enterprise Systems and Software Delivery
new_jobs.description:
Head of Information Technology - Enterprise Systems and Software Delivery
AutoShack - Kanata, Ontario

$160,000-$190,000 per year | Full-time, permanent | On-site

About AutoShack AutoShack is an established automotive parts company with approximately 170 employees, a large distribution centre, 13 Ontario retail locations and significant Canadian and U.S. e-commerce operations. We are continuing to expand our retail and online business.
The Position The Head of Information Technology is accountable for the reliable 24/7 operation of AutoShack's business-critical technology across e-commerce, retail, warehouse and corporate operations. The role leads enterprise systems, software development, integrations, automation, AI, projects and day-to-day IT operations. It manages a small internal team, developers, service providers and specialist contractors.
This is an applications and software-delivery leadership role, not a network administrator position. The Head of IT needs enough network, infrastructure and cybersecurity knowledge to manage providers and risk. The main focus is business systems, software, automation, daily operations and BCDR.
Key Responsibilities ·    Own the 24/7 availability and performance of enterprise systems, software, integrations and daily IT operations, including service levels, security and BCDR.
·    Lead the internal IT team, software developers, service providers and specialist contractors with clear priorities and accountability.
·    Own the roadmap and performance of ERP, WMS, e-commerce, PIM, integration, contact-centre and other business-critical platforms supporting company growth.
·    Direct internal and contracted software development, including requirements, estimates, architecture, testing, change control, releases, documentation and support.
·    Ensure APIs, integrations and data flows between systems are reliable, secure, documented and properly monitored.
·    Evaluate practical AI and automation opportunities, protect company data, use the right internal or outside resources and confirm measurable business value.
·    Work with department leaders to translate operating requirements into practical system changes and continuity procedures that protect critical operating processes.
·    Assign internal or outside resources, set clear owners, hours, costs and delivery dates, remove roadblocks and drive work through to completion.
·    Manage technology projects from scope and budget through development, testing, deployment and support, and deliver the agreed result on time and within budget.
·    Manage software vendors, licensing, contracts, renewals, service levels and outside development work, and challenge unnecessary costs or complexity.
·    Provide brief, accurate updates on results, major risks, costs and decisions required without unnecessary reporting.
·    Manage service providers and contractors used across IT and hold them accountable for cost, quality, service levels and delivery.
·    Own cybersecurity governance, identity and access, monitoring, backups, disaster recovery and incident response, while ensuring providers meet their obligations.
·    Maintain and regularly test BCDR plans for critical systems and operating processes, including backup restoration, recovery priorities, responsibilities, escalation contacts and temporary workarounds.
·    Maintain accurate records for systems, access, decisions, changes, project status, vendor contacts, contracts and recovery procedures without allowing administration to delay execution.
·    Maintain appropriate monitoring, incident escalation and support coverage for 24/7 operations, and reduce repeat issues.
Enterprise Technology Environment ·    NetSuite ERP and retail WMS
·    Manhattan SCALE warehouse management system
·    Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Marketing Cloud
·    Dell Boomi integrations, APIs and automated data flows
·    Marketplace feeds, e-commerce integrations and custom applications
·    Talkdesk contact-centre platform
·    Microsoft 365, endpoints, network services, cybersecurity, backup and disaster recovery
·    Internal and contracted developers, managed service and technology vendors
Required Qualifications ·    At least 10 years of progressive IT experience, including five years leading an IT team or function.
·    Experience managing IT in a mid-sized, multi-location business.
·    Proven experience leading developers, contracted development, enterprise applications and technology providers.
·    Strong knowledge of ERP, WMS, e-commerce, PIM, middleware, APIs and integrations.
·    Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle, from requirements and estimates through testing, release, source control and documentation.
·    Practical understanding of AI and automation, including data privacy, security, accuracy, vendor risk and business value.
·    Proven delivery of enterprise-system implementations and software projects, with accountability for developer quality, budget and deadlines.
·    Proven experience developing and testing BCDR plans for critical systems and business processes.
·    Working knowledge of networks, infrastructure and cybersecurity sufficient to direct providers, assess risk and maintain reliable operations.
·    A record of setting priorities, solving problems and completing work with accurate documentation.
·    Strong business judgment and the ability to explain technical issues in clear, direct language.
·    Excellent written and spoken English.
·    Proven accountability for 24/7 critical IT operations, including incident escalation, service continuity and vendor coordination.
·    Able to work on-site in Kanata five days per week.
Preferred Experience ·    Retail, distribution, warehouse, e-commerce or automotive-parts experience.
·    NetSuite, Manhattan SCALE, Salesforce Commerce Cloud or Dell Boomi experience.
·    Experience managing custom development, integrations, APIs, AI automation and data-quality improvements.
·    Experience supporting business expansion across multiple locations.
·    Experience improving an IT department by clarifying roles, reducing unnecessary work and using outside specialists effectively.
Our Workplace AutoShack is a practical, direct and results-focused company. We value hard work, accountability, sound judgment, professional conduct and consistent follow-through. This role is best suited to a business-minded, company-minded leader who puts the company's interests first, avoids unnecessary complexity, makes decisions, sets clear standards and takes responsibility for results.
Benefits Benefits include dental care, extended health care, life insurance, vision care and on-site parking.
Application and Screening Process Your resume must show systems managed, teams and providers led and completed projects with measurable results.
Shortlisted candidates will complete TestGorilla assessments in Software Engineering Management, Leadership and People Management, Business Judgment, Data Security and Compliance, and Communication Intermediate. Interviews will cover enterprise systems, software development, automation, AI, 24/7 operations and BCDR, followed by reference checks.
